bedDucking.rule: carve a -5.0 to -6.0 dB pocket in the music bed at every cue timestamp: enter ~0.15s ahead of the cue, hold through the cue body, release back to 0 dB once the cue decays; the end-card pocket holds at -6.0 dB until the exponential tail decay takes over
bedDucking.referencePocket: 8.35s 0dB -> 8.5s -5dB -> 8.9s -5dB -> 9.2s 0dB (compound push); 16.35s 0dB -> 16.5s -6dB held to 17.5s, then exponential decay to -60dB at 20.0s
